sentences.text:
Coram : Smt. Anuja Prabhudessai, J.
 Dated : March 31, 2023
 P.C. :
1.

The Applicant has sought pre-arrest bail in Crime No. 542/2021 (R.C.C. No. 1177/2022) registered with Jail Road Police Station, District-Solapur City for the offences punishable under Section 3(1)(a), 3(1)(zz), 26(1), 26(2), 26(2)(i), 26(2)(a), 26(2)
(v), 27(3)(e) & 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and under Section 272, 273 & 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.

entities.text: Jail Road Police Station, District-Solapur City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The case of the prosecution is that 428 bottles of fruit beer, worth Rs. 12,840/- were seized from the co-accused.
It is alleged that the Applicant herein was the manufacturer of the said fruit beer bottles, which were found to be of sub-standard quality.
Considering the role attributed to the Applicant, this Court by order dated 11/01/2022 had granted interim bail to the Applicant, which is extended from time to time.
